The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|24}} when consumed. Since the items which can be used to craft an {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]]. {{PAGENAME}}s can also be purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].
